1. Open myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in in Chrome and sign in with your Aadhaar number and OTP. Use the website, not the Aadhaar app: the app keeps the file in its own folder where SafeRent cannot open it.
2. Go to Offline eKYC.
3. Make a 4 digit share code and download the ZIP file. It is saved in Downloads.
4. Tap Choose the ZIP file below, open Downloads (menu at the top left) and pick the file named offlineaadhaar followed by numbers, ending in .zip. You can also search offlineaadhaar.
5. Type the same share code.
